name: etf_integration

coverage.role: Require a source profile and fund identity at the information time; retain the parent ETF peer labels and categorical limits. Compare with the unchanged dated-stock baseline.

identity.role: Use the declared benchmark identity as the ETF peer group on the identical coverage mask. Compare with coverage; no daily constituent or economic-industry identity is implied.

reported.role: Use the identity arm's exact model table, peer targets, peer-neutral forecasts and peer-count selection rules; add the separately defined reported-equity concentration proxies to allocation, execution, paper and independent accounts. Compare with identity. No extra alpha feature or model candidate.

coverage.availability: Use the already checked session/profile index and its first-session boundaries. The report, summary, CAPCO and alias conventions are exactly those in etf_exposures.json; no same-day use, future backfill or return-selected freshness cutoff.
coverage.common_mask: Every arm requires the same available profile, positive reported NAV, validated partitions and declared benchmark. Missing profile means ineligible before ranks, labels and fitting. An already held fund losing required source coverage stops the account explicitly; do not fabricate liquidation.
coverage.freshness: Carry the latest available report under the frozen period-priority rule and record its period end/age. Do not treat its weights as daily holdings or tune an expiry using returns.
coverage.clocks: Signal features, peer labels and intentions use 16:00 on the signal day; execution and independent post-fill checks use 09:25 on the next session. A new opening profile cannot rewrite the preceding intention. Preview retains the signal information time.

peer_groups.stocks: Keep the existing dated CAPCO company division and all its unknown-stock rules.
peer_groups.funds: Coverage retains the parent label; identity/reported use benchmark:<reviewed key>. Legal fund type and literal benchmark wording remain separate evidence. No assignment of a diversified ETF to a guessed dominant company industry.
peer_groups.models: Reuse the 57-feature contract, minimum-three peer support, shrinkage, purged leave-own-out residual targets, peer weighting, prediction neutralization and holdout gates. Do not insert partial holdings as fractional label peers or train an additional alpha candidate.
peer_groups.selection: Keep the maximum-two-per-peer-group and correlation rules. Reported overlap is constrained quantitatively in target allocation and every opening buy; peer identity and economic exposure are not interchangeable.

reported_proxy.scope: A retrospective concentration proxy for the reviewed reported stock schedule and reported stock-index-futures contract market values. It is not a certified bound on full current economic industry exposure.
reported_proxy.known: k[f,c] is the exact matched named-stock CNY amount in CAPCO division c divided by source reported NAV. Preserve sleeves; no normalization of partial schedules.
reported_proxy.unknown_stock: u[f] is (unmatched named stocks + undisclosed stocks + abs(signed equity/sector residual)) / source NAV. Preserve each component and the signed residual separately. The absolute discrepancy is an uncertainty allowance, never a factual allocation to cash or a division and never a negative offset.
reported_proxy.reported_index_contracts: d[f] is the sum of absolute reported_market_value_cny over reviewed current stock_index_futures rows divided by source NAV. No netting by direction or P&L, no use of net derivative carrying value, no mapping a futures index to invented daily sectors. Empty rows mean no reported contract contribution, not certified absence of all derivatives. Preserve inherited currency-unit evidence.
reported_proxy.constraints: Keep each peer-group row (stocks CAPCO, funds benchmark) and its unchanged target 28% / post-fee buy 30% limit. For every represented CAPCO division, add ETF k[f,c]+u[f]+d[f] to direct stock exposure in that division. An additional unnamed-division row contains u[f]+d[f], so unknown stock cannot escape when no represented sector exists. This duplicates uncertainty across possible sectors for constraints only; it is not a partition to be summed as NAV.
reported_proxy.denominator: Multiply report NAV ratios by current ETF position market value as an explicit proxy convention. Fund premium/discount, report age and intervening trading make it uncertified for actual current holdings. Ratios above one are retained.
reported_proxy.other_assets: Non-equity source rows and gold/treasury/other contracts remain separately visible, with original asset/NAV denominators. Existing fund peer caps continue to constrain invested capital; they do not certify the underlying non-equity risk.
reported_proxy.unbounded: Unreviewed derivatives, convertible/option exposure, borrowing/lending inclusion and interim position changes have no certified finite economic bound. Store null/unknown plus a nonzero uncertified-fund-capital measure when held; never fill them with zero or present the reported proxy as complete exposure. Do not add source lending amounts to stocks where schedule inclusion is unproven, which could double-count.
reported_proxy.buy_and_sell: Use current profile coefficients in target LP, deadband feasibility, initial opening buy budget and every post-fee resize check. Preserve reductions, liquidity, lot rules and T+1. Passive reclassification is recorded and does not invent forced fills; any new buy must satisfy all current proxy and peer limits.
reported_proxy.audit: Independently rebuild monetary ratios from stored source amounts, opening-time profiles, reconciled quantities and price marks. Verify categorical and reported proxy concentrations, uncertainty contributions and uncertified capital after fills; compare each exact paper account. Never call the execution coefficient helper from the independent audit.

snapshot_checks: Before numerical edits, rebuild the complete parent with its original implementation and require exact meta, table, dtypes, masks, labels, panels, scores, raw bars, actions, calendar and opening status.

Independently reconstruct all 752 profiles and 15356 fund/session selections from the frozen reviewed inputs; independently check fractions, all 214 contract rows, known/unknown/residual components and scope flags.

Rebuild all three datasets from common raw input. Require identical eligibility and non-peer features across the three; identity/reported full tables, targets, panels, scores and labels must match exactly. Preserve the original metadata fields, adding source histories only.

Check missing/before-first source, opening versus signal boundaries, future truncation/poisoning, current omissions, signed residuals, no partial normalization, no P&L netting, unbounded components and order resizing after costs.

compatibility.scope: Explicit unchanged-input diagnostic; ordinary stale-source guards must still reject old models under changed source. No old training identity is rewritten.

fixed_forecasts: Coverage uses parent forecasts with only source-ineligible keys removed; identity uses coverage forecasts; reported uses identity forecasts. Separate attribution outputs, no calibration or ordinary identity-guard bypass. Compare fixed and fully refitted accounts and first differences.
attribution: All arms and all three costs: selected and same-input/same-risk momentum, continuous net return, drawdown, 10-session reset means, cash, turnover, costs, rejected/resized buys, source ages, known and uncertain proxies, uncertified fund capital, quality flags and per-window selections. Preserve failures; no best-arm selection.
risk: Balanced attack; 8% warning, original high-water mark and latched/non-recovering risk; unchanged position, cash, liquidity, lot, turnover and cost parameters. Whitepaper governs confirmed competition rules; unconfirmed fees and matching remain unresolved.
budget: Existing six single and two combination alpha experiments are exhausted. These three fixed data/measurement controls add no candidates and relax no gates; no taxonomy, freshness or uncertainty parameters may be chosen by returns.
adoption: Coverage and identity are attribution controls. Reported can become the retrospective research baseline only after all registered compatibility, source, snapshot, training, account, status and paper checks pass, regardless of return direction. Its complete-economic-exposure gate remains NOT_CERTIFIED. A new source-bound conditional paper plan is research-only and cannot supply invented future observations. Do not declare the whole remediation goal complete from these checks.
limitations: Reported holdings are not current full portfolios; unknown economic exposure has no certified bound.
Catalogue-plus-next-observed-session is a retrospective availability convention, not exact historical publication or historical-byte certification.
Current-universe selection, remaining action/status/quote gaps and unconfirmed competition execution assumptions persist.
Repeated historical research is not a new holdout. No superiority, guaranteed 8% ceiling, live fill or forward return is established.

design_reference.use: Reference only for separating a time-varying exposure matrix from portfolio weights; no third-party implementation copied. Missing-data treatment above is this project's registered modelling convention.
